title: Routed Test-Database Proof
description: End-to-end proof that test-genie's routed test-database path works for this scenario: the seed populates the per-run test pool, the running API routes UI requests to that pool via X-Vrooli-Test-Mode + RoutedDB, and the BAS playbook asserts the seeded row is visible in the UI. This module is the canonical reference exercise for the routed-e2e infrastructure (see scenarios/storage-manager/docs/concepts/test-isolation-contract.md).

requirements.title: Routed test pool reaches the UI via TestModeMiddleware + RoutedDB
requirements.description: When test-genie installs a per-run test pool on the running scenario and seeds it with a Golden row (slug 'routed-smoke-001'), the goldens index page rendered by the live UI must show that slug. The slug exists only in the test pool, so visibility proves the UI→API→RoutedDB chain routed the request to the test pool rather than the primary.
